about: V3's first live zone (Strategy's live-zone brief, phase 1), in the shape of V1's origins/zone-rows/zone7.row.json cut to what one player in one zone needs. Positions are metres in the zone's own frame (V1's: x east, z south; the same frame as the yard and the Duel pit area below). `respawn`: where a dead hero stands again at full health after `downSeconds` of `died` (the 'You died' beat, V1 main.ts:1030). `areas`: rectangles (V1 safeAreas): `pvp` is the area's own flag, `spawnsAllowed` false keeps every spawn row out of it. `spawns`: one row per creature camp (live-zone phase 1b: three Pitborn stand at their own spots, in the Duel pit area and the `field` area, which allow spawns; each has its own respawnSeconds; aggro 2.5 m, not V1's open-field 4; Dom 2026-10-27 'space them about two times apart', then spread across the world (see Spread below), the yard Pitborn 6 m from where the newcomer stands; LEASH, Dom 2026-10-27 'it should be a free roam area' (a roll out of 5 m reset the fight): the leash is the BOSS's own distance from its spot, not the hero's, and must be at least the aggro plus respawn.json world.leashMargin (validated, src/zone/spawns.ts validateSpots), so a roll or a fight never trips it; a hero who runs off drags the boss until it lets go at the leash (20 m). A kited boss that reaches another camp does not chain: that neighbour keeps its own aggro and leash; a boss that lets go resets alone, the hero's health and every other boss's fight are untouched); BOSS ORDER (Dom 2026-10-28: the Gargantua first, the Arachne second, the Minotaur third): spawn 1 (the opener, at the start mark) is kind gargantua, the east spawn arachne, the west spawn pitborn (the Minotaur); the spawn ids keep their old names (they are keys other rows name). ?order=v1 (data/fight.json order) restores Minotaur, Gargantua, Arachne. `kind` is an opponent profile id (today the opponent data/fight.json names; the difficulty profile rows replace it later); `respawnSeconds` is V1 spawn rows' own field; `roster` says the creature appears in the zone's roster listing; `behaviour`: aggro and leash are metres, roam is metres per second of wander, campSize is [min, max] creatures per camp (capped by src/fight/world-rules-defs.json campMax at spawn). The default zone id is data/zones/index.json. Spread: the yard Pitborn stays where it was (the opener's boss, 6 m from the newcomer); the east and west Pitborn stand out in the `field` spawn area, 14 m east and 13.6 m south-west of the centre of the Duel pit area, 16 to 24 m from each other (data/respawn.json world.spreadRadiusMetres is the extent spots may go to). Validated by src/sim/validate.js validateZone; read by src/zone/zone-rows.ts only.
